newsitem.title: USA: Excel ups ante, offers six-second billing.
newsitem.headline: Excel ups ante, offers six-second billing.

text.p: Excel Communications Inc said Thursday it will offer six-second billing on its two residential flat-rate calling plans, EXCEL Simply One and PremierPlus II, beginning November 1.
Six-second billing means customers are charged to the nearest six seconds rather than by the minute for short calls.

Excel is one of over 400 telephone resellers in the communications industry who together have been growing at a rate of 31 percent a year, compared to five percent for the overall long distance industry.

Excel reported earnings per share of $0.36 in the second quarter, a 350 percent increase from $0.08 a year earlier. In August the company said it was expecting record earnings for the third quarter and the year.
On Thursday its stock closed at 24-5/8, after opening at 25.
